book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
stem_md: 设 $a, b, c, d \in \mathbf{R}_+$ 满足 $abcd = 1$, $a + b + c + d > \frac{a}{b} + \frac{b}{c} + \frac{c}{d} + \frac{d}{a}$. 求证: $a + b + c + d < \frac{b}{a} + \frac{c}{b} + \frac{d}{c} + \frac{a}{d}$.
original_text_md: 设 $a, b, c, d \in \mathbf{R}_+$ 满足 $abcd = 1$, $a + b + c + d > \frac{a}{b} + \frac{b}{c} + \frac{c}{d} + \frac{d}{a}$. 求证: $a + b + c + d < \frac{b}{a} + \frac{c}{b} + \frac{d}{c} + \frac{a}{d}$.
